name: @guardbee/mcp-context-oversharing-auditor
description: MCP server that audits agent/MCP source for OWASP MCP10:2025 context oversharing — unrestricted session/memory dumps, cross-user shared context, system-prompt leakage via tools, and unscoped vector recalls
long_description: OWASP MCP10:2025 covers toxic flows and context oversharing. GuardBee's toxic-flow-auditor grades tool-catalog combinations (lethal trifecta). This package statically scans TypeScript and Python agent/MCP source for a different failure mode: returning more session, memory, or system context than the current principal should see — full conversation dumps, dump_memory-style tools, global session Maps, system-prompt returns, cross-session tool-result reuse, and vector queries without tenant/user filters. No API key required — runs entirely locally.
